facts.fact: 约翰逊指出 1970–80 年代吸血鬼片的两个特点：数量极多、跨语言，且多数含明确的 sapphic 内容；她把它与 1922 年《Nosferatu》、1931 年《Dracula》、1936 年《Dracula’s Daughter》的旧传统区分开。
facts.quote: VAMPIRE FILMS were not unique to the 1970s and 1980s; they go back to the 1920s and 1930s, with Nosferatu (1922), Dracula (1931), and our favorite, Dracula’s Daughter (1936). Two things make the 1970s vampire movies distinct. First, a gigantic number of them appeared, across many languages, in a very short period. Second, the majority include explicit sapphism.

facts.fact: 作者主张：sapphic eros 的「复活与部分救赎」使「怪物母狗」得以成为女主角，但她们仍会杀人、常在结尾死去，或最终被异性恋收编。
facts.quote: That resurrection and partial redemption of sapphic eros enables the emergence of Monstrous Bitches as heroines or protagonists, even if their heroism and leading-lady status are attenuated by the fact that they kill people, often die in the end, and sometimes ultimately get absorbed into heterosexuality.

facts.fact: 《The Vampire Lovers》(1970) 中，Marcilla（Carmilla 的易位构词）主动引诱 Laura，唤她「my dearest Laura」并吻她的嘴，Laura 日渐虚弱、最终死去。
facts.quote: Soon thereafter, Marcilla begins to seduce Laura in earnest, telling her she’ll never leave her, calling her “my dearest Laura,” and kissing her on the mouth. With Marcilla’s attentions, Laura grows ill, declining into weakness and torpor; even if we haven’t read Le Fanu’s novella, we know that Marcilla is draining her somehow. Laura soon dies.

facts.fact: 该片结尾，Laura 与 Emma 的父亲们（父权制的化身）识破 Carmilla 的计划，将她刺穿并斩首，女吸血鬼终被消灭。
facts.quote: Just when we think that Carmilla will successfully convert Emma to vampirism, Patriarchy, here embodied in the fathers of Laura and of Emma, catches on to Carmilla’s plan, catches up with her, and destroys her. Specifically, she is both staked and decapitated.

facts.fact: 《The Velvet Vampire》(1971) 里 Diane 再次引诱 Lee，随后吸干并杀死他；作者强调她对 Lee 的欲望只是交易性的，真正的目标始终是 Susan。
facts.quote: When Lee finds “that bitch,” however, Diane simply seduces him again, then finally drains him and kills him. As was the case for Carmilla in Vampire Lovers, Diane’s desire is only transactionally about Lee; it’s primarily and centrally about Susan.

facts.fact: 本章转折点：作者判定 1970 年代初的吸血鬼片仍与 1960 年代巫术片的倒退政治同调，但 1974 年的《Vampyres》起，女吸血鬼成为明确的女主角，「她们不会在结尾死去」。
facts.quote: That will not be true, however, in the 1974 film Vampyres. In this film, we’ll start to see our vampiric lesbian Monstrous Bitches far more unequivocally as our heroines. And crucially, they won’t die in the end.

facts.fact: 《Vampyres》(1974) 的 Fran 与 Miriam 是现代版 Lilith，拒绝服从男性权威、以男人的血为食，并「存活下去，改日再引诱、吸血、屠杀」——作者称之为该子类型的「第二个重大转变」。
facts.quote: Instead, these two vampires—Fran and Miriam—are modern-day liliths, refusing to submit to male authority, reveling in the blood and bodies of women, while also disrupting the patriarchal sexual patterns of adult men. And significantly, in this film, the sapphists survive to seduce, drain, and slaughter another day.

facts.fact: 《The Hunger》(1983) 中 Miriam（Catherine Deneuve）以德利布的《Lakme》为引，把 Sarah Roberts（Susan Sarandon）带进卧室，做爱时偷偷咬开两人的手臂混血，在 Sarah 不知情、未同意的情况下把她转化为吸血鬼。
facts.quote: Immediately thereafter, Sarah and Miriam repair to the bedroom for a glorious sapphic sexcapade, with “Lakme” playing in the background all the while. While they make love, Miriam surreptitiously bites her own arm and Sarah’s, combining their blood in Sarah’s body, thereby initiating the process of converting her to a vampire.
